nominal.grid: lines every 10 mm; counting from one corner, every 5 lines one bold line; bold lines numbered in cm along two margins
nominal.kind: grey self-healing cutting mat with a printed grid
nominal.name: mat

nominal.graduation: 1 mm ticks along one long edge; longer ticks every 5 mm and every 10 mm; numbered every 10 mm (0 .. 30 = centimetres)
nominal.name: rule_a

nominal.kind: checkerboard calibration target printed on a flat rigid board
nominal.name: checker

nominal.graduation: 1 mm ticks along one long edge; longer ticks every 5 mm and every 10 mm; numbered every 10 mm (0 .. 30 = centimetres)
nominal.name: rule_b
